description: This file defines two internal structs, SpanFormattableIPEndPoint and SpanFormattableIPAddress, which implement the ISpanFormattable interface for formatting IP endpoints and IP addresses respectively. It provides custom span-based formatting logic for these network address types.

classes.name: SpanFormattableIPEndPoint
classes.description: A struct that provides span-based formatting for IPEndPoint objects.

classes.name: SpanFormattableIPAddress
classes.description: A struct that provides span-based formatting for IPAddress objects.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns the default string representation of the object.

methods.name: ToString (with format and provider)
methods.description: Returns a formatted string representation based on provided format and format provider.

methods.name: TryFormat
methods.description: Attempts to format the address/IP endpoint into a span of characters.
